note: Shared glossary for all parts (fitts) of Beowulf. Entries keyed by word form as printed in Klaeber 1922, lowercased, editorial brackets/parentheses stripped. Lemma — meaning (grammatical info).

glossary.hwæt: hwæt — what! lo! (interjection calling for attention; also the pronoun 'what') · hwæt — something, anything (indefinite pronoun, accusative singular neuter; swulces hwæt 'something of the sort') · hwæt — what (pronoun, accusative singular neuter, object of gefremedon; hwæt wit ... gefremedon 'what we two did')
glossary.gār-dena: Gār-Dene — of the Spear-Danes (genitive plural; gār 'spear' + Dene 'Danes')
glossary.in: in — in, into, within (preposition) · in — in, inside (adverb; ǣr hē in wille 'before he will go in')
glossary.gēardagum: gēardagas — in days of yore (dative plural; gēar 'year' + dagas 'days')
glossary.þēodcyninga: þēodcyning — of the people-kings (genitive plural; þēod 'people, nation' + cyning 'king')
glossary.gefrūnon: gefrignan — (we) have heard of, learned by inquiry (1st plural preterite)
glossary.ðā: sē/þā — the, those (nominative plural of the demonstrative); as adverb: then · þā — those, the (accusative plural of the demonstrative) · þā — when (conjunction; ðā ic of searwum cwōm 'when I came from') · þā — then (adverb; nū ðā 'just now') · þā — who, which (relative, nominative plural, referring to a plural antecedent)
glossary.ellen: ellen — courage, valor, mighty deeds (accusative singular) · ellen — courage, valor (nominative singular neuter, subject of dēah)
glossary.scyld: Scyld — Scyld, mythical founder of the Danish royal house (nominative) · scyld — shield (accusative singular masculine; sīdne scyld 'broad shield')
glossary.monegum: monig — many (dative plural) · monig — many (dative singular masculine, agreeing with ðegne)
glossary.meodosetla: meodosetl — of mead-seats, mead-benches (genitive plural, object of oftēah; medu 'mead' + setl 'seat')
glossary.oftēah: oftēon — took away, deprived of (3rd singular preterite; takes a genitive object)
glossary.eorlas: eorl — warriors, nobles (accusative plural; the MS reads 'eorl' — the ending is Klaeber's emendation, hence the brackets)
glossary.syððan: siþþan — after, since, from the time when (conjunction)
glossary.wearð: weorðan — became, was (3rd singular preterite; auxiliary of the passive: 'was found')
glossary.þæs: þæt — for that, of that (genitive singular of the demonstrative: 'comfort for that') · se — of the (genitive singular neuter article, before a noun: þæs recedes 'of the hall') · þes — this (demonstrative, nominative singular masculine; the manuscript's þæs for þes, in þæs sele 'this hall') · þæs — so, to that degree (genitive singular of the demonstrative used adverbially; þæs fæste 'so firmly') · þæs — of this (genitive, as object of wēndon: Þæs ne wēndon 'did not expect this') · þæs — as, according as (genitive singular of the demonstrative, with the relative particle: þæs þe 'in so far as, as')
glossary.frōfre: frōfor — comfort, consolation, help (feminine; genitive/dative/accusative singular)
glossary.gebād: gebīdan — experienced, lived to see (3rd singular preterite; takes the genitive)
glossary.under: under — under, beneath (preposition) · under — beneath, below (adverb, after its noun)
glossary.wolcnum: wolcen — under the clouds, the skies (dative plural; cf. archaic English 'welkin')
glossary.weorðmyndum: weorðmynd — in honors, marks of esteem (dative plural)
glossary.him: hē — to him, or to them (dative singular or plural of hē) · hē — to himself, for themselves (reflexive dative, pleonastic: gewiton him 'they went off') · hē — to it (neuter dative singular; hīe him tō 'they to it')
glossary.ǣghwylc: ǣghwylc — each, every one (pronoun) · ǣghwylc — each, every (adjective, with eorl: ǣghwylc eorl 'each man')
glossary.ymbsittendra: ymbsittend — of the around-sitters, neighboring peoples (genitive plural; present participle of ymbsittan 'to sit around')
glossary.ofer: ofer — over, across (preposition) · ofer — beyond, without (preposition with accusative; wīg ofer wǣpen 'battle without a weapon')
glossary.hronrāde: hronrād — whale-road = the sea (accusative singular; the poem's first kenning: hron 'whale' + rād 'road, riding')
glossary.hȳran: hȳran — to obey, hearken to (infinitive; takes the dative)
glossary.scolde: sculan — had to, was obliged to (3rd singular preterite) · sculan — should, were to (3rd singular preterite subjunctive in a condition; gyf ... scolde 'if ... should') · sculan — was to, should (3rd singular preterite, indicative or subjunctive, in a clause after a verb of trusting or expecting; gelȳfde þæt ... scolde 'trusted that ... should') · sculan — should, were to (1st singular preterite subjunctive in a condition; gif ic scolde 'if I should')
glossary.gomban: gombe — tribute (accusative singular; a rare, old word)
glossary.wæs: wesan — was (3rd singular preterite) · wesan — be (imperative singular; Wæs þū hāl 'be hale', a greeting)
glossary.cyning: cyning — king (nominative singular) · cyning — king (accusative singular, object of gecēosenne; cyning ǣnigne 'any king')
glossary.ðǣm: sē — to that one, to him (dative singular of the demonstrative) · sē — to whom (dative singular, relative; ðǣm ... forgeaf 'to whom ... gave') · sē — to those, on those (dative plural of the demonstrative; on ðǣm scennum 'on the plates') · sē — which, in which (dative singular neuter, relative after a preposition; on ðǣm wæs ōr writen 'on which was written the beginning')
glossary.æfter: æfter — after, afterward (adverb, preposition) · æfter — about, concerning (preposition with dative: asking after a person) · æfter — along, following (preposition with dative) · æfter — according to (preposition with dative; sōð æfter rihte 'truth according to right')
glossary.geong: geong — young (adjective; in line 20 restored — the MS is burned, only '…uma' survives)
glossary.geardum: geard — in the courts, dwellings (dative plural; geard 'yard, enclosure' — cf. middangeard 'middle-earth')
glossary.þone: sē — whom, that (accusative singular masculine of the demonstrative, here relative) · sē — that (accusative singular masculine of the demonstrative, qualifying a noun: þone hilderǣs 'that battle-rush')
glossary.god: God — God (nominative) · God — God (accusative, after wið; fāg wið God 'at feud with God')
glossary.folce: folc — to the folk, people (dative singular)
glossary.tō: tō — to, as, for (preposition) · tō — too (adverb; tō swȳð 'too severe') · tō — to (particle before the inflected infinitive: tō gecȳðanne 'for declaring') · tō — to, toward (adverb separated from its goal; tō ... gegnum gangan 'go straight to it') · tō — to (before a bare infinitive: tō fēran 'to go') · tō — from, at the hands of (preposition with dative, after wēnan; secce ne wēneþ tō Gār-Denum 'expects no strife from the Spear-Danes') · tō — until (in tō þæs þe, a conjunctive phrase: preposition with the genitive of the demonstrative and the relative particle) · tō — at, by (preposition with dative, of position: tō hēafdon 'at their heads') · tō — against, towards (preposition with dative, of hostility: fǣhðe tō Frȳsum 'feud against the Frisians') · tō — at, on (verbal adverb or prefix; tō sǣgon 'looked on') · tō — to such a degree, so (preposition with the genitive of the demonstrative, adverbial phrase tō þæs hāt 'so hot') · tō — to such a degree, so (preposition with the instrumental of the demonstrative; tō þon lēof þæt 'so dear that')
glossary.fyrenðearfe: fyrenðearf — dire distress (accusative singular; fyren 'crime, torment' + ðearf 'need')
glossary.ongeat: ongietan — perceived, understood, had seen (3rd singular preterite)
glossary.þē: þe — which, that (relative particle; Klaeber prints þē, emended — the MS has only 'þ') · þū — you (dative singular: to you, with you) · þū — you (accusative singular; þæt ic þē sōhte 'that I should seek you') · sē — the, by that (instrumental singular of the demonstrative, before a comparative; þē geornor 'the more clearly') · þū — you, yourself (reflexive dative; þū þē self 'you yourself') · þe — when, after (relative particle, if þē is taken as the sense of the clause requires; þē se āglǣca ... gewand 'when the awesome one ... turned', where several editors print þā; a guess)
glossary.hīe: hīe — they (nominative plural) · hīe — them (accusative plural)
glossary.ǣr: ǣr — before, previously (adverb; cf. archaic 'ere') · ǣr — before (conjunction; ǣr gē 'before you') · ǣr — sooner, earlier (adverb, with a comparative sense; nō þȳ ǣr 'none the sooner') · ǣr — before (preposition with dative; ǣr dēaþe 'before death')
glossary.drugon: drēogan — suffered, endured (3rd plural preterite; cf. Scots 'dree')
glossary.aldorlēase: aldorlēas — lord-less, without a chief (aldor 'lord, elder' + -lēas '-less'; printed aldor(lē)ase — the letters in parentheses are restored from the burned MS)
glossary.lange: lang — long (adjective/adverb; lange hwīle 'a long while')
glossary.hwīle: hwīl — while, space of time (accusative singular)
glossary.līffreâ: līffrēa — Lord of life, God (nominative singular; līf 'life' + frēa 'lord'; the circumflex is Klaeber's mark for a contracted vowel)
glossary.wealdend: wealdend — Wielder, Ruler (nominative singular; a title of God)
glossary.bēowulf: Bēowulf — Beowulf; here Scyld's son, the Danish king — not the poem's hero (nominative) · Bēowulf — Beowulf, son of Ecgtheow, the Geatish hero (nominative; accusative as object of nemnað) · Bēowulf — Beowulf the Geat (vocative, in address)
glossary.scedelandum: Scedeland — in the Scede-lands, southern Scandinavia (dative plural; cf. Skåne, Scania)
glossary.sceal: sculan — shall, must, ought by nature to (3rd singular present) · sculan — must, shall (1st singular present; ic sceal 'I must')
glossary.guma: guma — man (nominative singular; poetic word; printed (geong g)uma — restored from the burned MS) · guma — man (vocative singular; snotor guma 'wise man!')
glossary.gōde: gōd — good (here the noun: 'with good, by good action', dative singular)
glossary.gewyrcean: gewyrcan — to bring about, achieve, earn (infinitive)
glossary.fromum: from — splendid, bold, generous (dative plural adjective)
glossary.feohgiftum: feohgift — with treasure-gifts (dative plural; feoh 'wealth, cattle' — cognate with 'fee' — + gift)
glossary.fæder: fæder — father (here genitive: 'father's') · fæder — father (nominative singular; mīn fæder 'my father'; also God: Fæder alwalda 'Father almighty') · fæder — father (accusative singular, object of cunnon; hīe fæder cunnon 'they know no father')
glossary.bearme: bearm — in the bosom, lap (dative singular; in line 21 printed (bea)rme — restored from the burned MS)
glossary.hine: hē — him (accusative singular) · hē — himself (reflexive accusative singular; hylde hine 'laid himself down')
glossary.ylde: yldo — old age (dative singular; on ylde 'in old age')
glossary.gewunigen: gewunian — may remain with, stand by (3rd plural present subjunctive)
glossary.wilgesīþas: wilgesīþ — willing companions (nominative plural; willa 'goodwill, desire' + gesīþ 'companion')
glossary.þonne: þonne — when, whenever; than (conjunction) · þonne — then, at that time (adverb)
glossary.wīg: wīg — war, battle (nominative singular) · wīg — war, battle (accusative singular neuter; object of gesēcean) · wīg — war, battle (accusative singular neuter, cognate object of gefeohtan 'fight a fight')
glossary.cume: cuman — may come (3rd singular present subjunctive)
glossary.lēode: lēode — people, men (nominative plural) · lēode — people, men (accusative plural) · lēode — of the people (genitive plural, an odd form for lēoda; ēower lēode 'of your people', lēode Deniga 'of the people of the Danes')
glossary.gelǣsten: gelǣstan — may stand by, serve, follow (3rd plural present subjunctive; cf. 'last')
glossary.lofdǣdum: lofdǣd — by praise-deeds, praiseworthy deeds (dative plural; lof 'praise' + dǣd 'deed')
glossary.gehwǣre: gehwā — in each (dative singular feminine; mǣgþa gehwǣre 'in each of tribes')
glossary.man: mann — man, one (nominative singular) · mann — man (accusative singular, subject of an infinitive after lǣt: wīdcūðne man habban 'let the far-famed man have')
glossary.geþeôn: geþēon — to thrive, prosper (infinitive; the circumflex is Klaeber's mark for a contracted vowel)
glossary.gewāt: gewītan — departed, went (3rd singular preterite; him gewāt 'took himself off')
glossary.gescæphwīle: gescæphwīl — the shaped hour, appointed time of death (dative singular; gesceap 'destiny, what is shaped' + hwīl 'time')
glossary.felahrōr: felahrōr — very vigorous, still strong (adjective; fela 'much' + hrōr 'active, strong')
glossary.frēan: frēa — of the Lord (genitive singular of frēa 'lord'; here God) · frēa — lord, king (dative singular, weak; frēan Scyldinga 'to the lord of the Scyldings') · frēa — lord, king (accusative singular, weak; frēan Scildinga frīnan 'to ask the lord of the Scyldings')
glossary.wǣre: wǣr — keeping, protection; covenant (accusative singular) · wesan — were (3rd singular preterite subjunctive; 'though he were dear') · wesan — were, would be (2nd singular preterite subjunctive; þæt ðū mē ā wǣre 'that you would be to me')
glossary.hyne: hē — him (accusative singular, variant of hine)
glossary.ætbǣron: ætberan — carried, bore (to a place) (3rd plural preterite)
glossary.brimes: brim — of the sea, the surf (genitive singular)
glossary.faroðe: faroð — to the current, the shore-water (dative singular)
glossary.swǣse: swǣs — dear, beloved, own (nominative plural) · swǣs — dear, own (adjective, accusative plural, agreeing with lēode: lēode swǣse 'his own dear people')
glossary.þenden: þenden — while, as long as (conjunction; archaic) · þenden — then, at that time (conjunction used loosely as an adverb; nalles fācenstafas ... þenden fremedon 'not at all did they then do deeds of treachery'; or 'while this lasted')
glossary.wēold: wealdan — wielded, ruled (3rd singular preterite; takes the dative)
glossary.wine: wine — friend, friend-and-lord (nominative singular; wine Scyldinga 'friend of the Scyldings') · wine — friend (accusative singular) · wine — friend (vocative singular, in address)
glossary.scyldinga: Scyldingas — of the Scyldings, the descendants of Scyld = the Danes (genitive plural)
glossary.lēof: lēof — dear, beloved (adjective; cf. archaic 'lief') · lēof — dear one, friend (adjective used as a noun, nominative singular masculine; nē lēof nē lāð 'neither friend nor foe')
glossary.landfruma: landfruma — land-chief, ruler of the land (nominative singular; land + fruma 'first one, chief')
glossary.āhte: āgan — possessed, ruled (3rd singular preterite; cognate with 'ought', 'owe') · āgan — had, possessed (1st singular preterite)
glossary.þǣr: þǣr — there (adverb) · þǣr — where (relative adverb; þǣr ic fīfe geband 'where I bound five') · þǣr — if, provided that (conjunction; þǣr hē meahte swā 'if he could so')
glossary.æt: æt — at (preposition) · æt — from, at the hands of (preposition with dative; geþeah æt Wealhþeôn 'received from Wealhtheow')
glossary.hȳðe: hȳð — at the harbor, landing-place (dative singular; survives in place-names: Hythe, Rotherhithe)
glossary.hringedstefna: hringedstefna — the ring-prowed ship (nominative singular; hringed 'ringed, ring-adorned' + stefna 'prow')
glossary.īsig: īsig — icy (adjective; a famous crux — 'shining', 'ready', and other meanings have been proposed; no one knows)
glossary.ond: ond — and (the usual spelling of and in this MS)
glossary.ūtfūs: ūtfūs — eager to set out (adjective; ūt 'out' + fūs 'eager, ready')
glossary.æþelinges: æþeling — of the prince, atheling (genitive singular)
glossary.fær: fær — vessel, craft (nominative singular; related to faran 'to fare, travel')
glossary.þā: þā — then (adverb); also: those, the (plural demonstrative); who, which (relative) · when (conjunction) · þā — the (accusative singular feminine of the demonstrative before a noun)
glossary.þēoden: þēoden — lord, chief of a people (accusative singular; from þēod 'people') · þēoden — lord (vocative singular) · þēoden — lord, prince (masculine, nominative singular)
glossary.bēaga: bēag — of rings (genitive plural; gold arm-rings, the currency of reward)
glossary.bryttan: brytta — dispenser, distributor (accusative singular; bēaga brytta 'giver of rings' = generous lord)
glossary.bearm: bearm — bosom, lap; hold (accusative singular; on bearm scipes 'into the ship's bosom') · bearm — bosom, lap (nominative singular masculine, in apposition; foldan bearm 'the bosom of the earth')
glossary.be: be — by, beside (preposition) · be — about, concerning (preposition with dative; a restored word before a name: 'about Finn's sons') · be — in comparison with, beside (preposition with dative; wīggryre wīfes be wǣpnedmen 'a woman's war-terror beside a man's')
glossary.mādma: māðum — of treasures (genitive plural; mādma fela 'many of treasures')
glossary.fela: fela — many, much (indeclinable; takes the genitive)
glossary.of: of — from, out of (preposition) · of — off (adverb, with the verb detached: of dyde 'took off')
glossary.feorwegum: feorweg — from far-ways, distant regions (dative plural; feor 'far' + weg 'way')
glossary.frætwa: frætwe — of ornaments, trappings (genitive plural) · frætwe — ornaments, treasures (accusative plural, object of a verb; beorhte frætwa 'bright treasures')
glossary.hȳrde: hȳran — heard (1st singular preterite; ne hȳrde ic 'I have not heard') · hȳran — heard (3rd singular preterite; hē hȳrde 'he heard')
glossary.cȳmlīcor: cȳmlīce — more becomingly, more handsomely (comparative adverb)
glossary.gegyrwan: gegyrwan — to equip, adorn, make ready (infinitive)
glossary.hildewǣpnum: hildewǣpen — with battle-weapons (dative plural; hild 'battle' + wǣpen 'weapon')
glossary.heaðowǣdum: heaðowǣd — with war-garments, armor (dative plural; heaðu 'war' + wǣd 'garment' — cf. 'widow's weeds')
glossary.billum: bill — with swords (dative plural; an old word for sword)
glossary.mid: mid — with (preposition; here after its object: him mid 'with him') · mid — with (preposition; also before its object: mid Gēatum 'with the Geats')
glossary.scoldon: sculan — had to, were destined to (3rd plural preterite)
glossary.flōdes: flōd — of the flood, the sea (genitive singular)
glossary.ǣht: ǣht — possession, keeping (accusative singular; from āgan 'to own')
glossary.nalæs: nalæs — not at all, by no means (adverb; from ne + ealles)
glossary.lǣssan: lǣssa — lesser, smaller (dative plural; comparative of lȳtel 'little') · lǣssa — less, lesser (weak adjective used as a noun, dative singular neuter after for: 'for less')
glossary.tēodan: tēon — furnished, provided, adorned (3rd plural preterite)
glossary.þēodgestrēonum: þēodgestrēon — with people-treasures, treasures of a nation (dative plural; þēod 'people' + gestrēon 'treasure')
glossary.þon: þon — than (the manuscript's own form, kept by Klaeber; most editors emend to þon[ne]) · þon — by that, the (instrumental of the demonstrative; þon mā 'the more, any more') · þon — that (instrumental of the demonstrative; æfter þon 'after that'; ǣr þon 'before', as a conjunction 'ere')
glossary.frumsceafte: frumsceaft — first creation, origin, beginning (dative singular; fruma 'first' + sceaft 'shaping')
glossary.ȳðe: ȳð — over the wave (accusative singular) · ȳþe — easy (adjective, nominative singular neuter, predicative; Nō þæt ȳðe byð 'that is not easy'; a different word from ȳð 'wave')
glossary.umbọrwesende: umbọrwesende — being an infant (accusative singular; umbor 'infant' + wesende, present participle of wesan 'to be')
glossary.gȳt: gȳt — yet, still, further (adverb; þā gȳt 'then still, moreover')
glossary.āsetton: āsettan — set up, placed (3rd plural preterite)
glossary.segen: segn — banner, standard (accusative singular; from Latin signum)
glossary.gyldenne: gylden — golden (accusative singular masculine; printed g(yl)denne — restored from the burned MS)
glossary.hēafod: hēafod — head (accusative singular) · hēafod — head (neuter, nominative singular, subject of a passive verb)
glossary.holm: holm — the sea, the deep (accusative singular) · holm — the sea (nominative singular, subject of wēol)
glossary.gārsecg: gārsecg — the ocean, the open sea (accusative singular; an obscure old word, literally perhaps 'spear-man')
glossary.mōd: mōd — mind, heart, spirit (nominative singular; cf. 'mood') · mōd — mind, spirit (accusative singular, object of forstandan)
glossary.men: mann — men (nominative plural) · mann — man (dative singular, umlaut form; gūþmōdgum men 'to the battle-minded man') · mann — men (accusative plural)
glossary.cunnon: cunnan — know how to, are able (3rd plural present; cf. 'can') · cunnan — know, are acquainted with (3rd plural present, with the accusative; hīe fæder cunnon 'they know no father')
glossary.sōðe: sōð — truth (dative singular; tō sōðe 'in sooth, for a truth') · sōð — truly, in truth (adverb, from the dative form of sōð 'truth')
glossary.selerǣdende: selerǣdend — hall-counselors (nominative plural; sele 'hall' + rǣdend 'counselor'; emended — the MS reads selerædenne) · selerǣdend — hall-counselor (accusative plural, in apposition to londbūend, with it the object of hȳrde; selerǣdende secgan hȳrde 'I heard hall-counselors say')
glossary.hæleð: hæleð — heroes, men (nominative plural) · hæleð — hero, man (nominative singular)
glossary.þǣm: sē — that (dative singular: 'that cargo') · sē — which (dative singular, relative: on þǣm 'in which') · sē — the, that (dative singular masculine, before a weak adjective: tō þǣm mǣran 'to the famous one') · sē — those (dative plural, before a noun) · sē — the (dative singular masculine, before a noun; in þǣm gūðsele 'in the war-hall') · sē — the one, he (dative singular masculine, a demonstrative serving as antecedent of a relative: þǣm þe 'to him who')
glossary.hlæste: hlæst — load, cargo (dative singular; cf. German Last)
glossary.onfēng: onfōn — received (3rd singular preterite; takes the dative) · onfōn — seized, took hold of (3rd singular preterite; hē onfēng hraþe 'he quickly grasped (him)')
glossary.burgum: burg — in the strongholds, fortified dwellings (dative plural; cf. ‑borough, ‑bury in place-names)
glossary.lēodcyning: lēodcyning — people-king, king of a nation (nominative singular; lēod 'people' + cyning)
glossary.longe: lange — long, for a long time (adverb; variant spelling)
glossary.þrāge: þrāg — time, span of time (accusative singular; longe þrāge 'for a long while')
glossary.folcum: folc — among the folks, peoples (dative plural)
glossary.gefrǣge: gefrǣge — famed, known by report (adjective; from gefrignan 'to learn by asking') · gefrǣge — hearsay, report (neuter noun, instrumental/dative singular; mīne gefrǣge 'by my hearing', 'as I have heard')

glossary.scaþan: scaþa — foe, marauder, ravager; of armed men, warrior (weak masculine, nominative plural; cf. 'scathe'; the sense warrior is a guess from context)
glossary.sceadwa: sceadu — shadow (feminine, accusative plural, after ofer; cf. 'shade')
glossary.scylding: Scylding — Scylding, descendant of Scyld, a Dane (masculine, nominative singular)
glossary.scēoteð: scēotan — shoots (3rd singular present, strong verb II; cf. 'shoot')
glossary.scīma: scīma — light, gleam, brightness (weak masculine, nominative singular; cf. 'shimmer')
glossary.seleþegn: seleþegn — hall-thane, hall-servant (masculine, nominative singular; sele 'hall' + þegn 'thane, servant')
glossary.seoþðan: siþþan — after, since (conjunction; a variant spelling of siþðan)
glossary.setles: setl — seat, resting place (neuter, genitive singular; nēosan takes the genitive; cf. 'settle')
glossary.sig: wesan — be, may it be (3rd singular present subjunctive, optative; a variant of sīe; þanc sig 'thanks be')
glossary.singāles: singāl — constant, continual (adjective, genitive singular used as an adverb, 'continually'; sin- 'ever' + -gāl)
glossary.starige: starian — gaze, stare (1st singular present subjunctive, weak verb II; cf. 'stare')
glossary.stefne: stefn — turn, time; voice (feminine, dative singular; nīowan stefne 'anew', literally 'at a new turn')
glossary.strǣle: strǣl — arrow (feminine, dative singular, instrumental 'by an arrow')
glossary.swæf: swefan — slept (3rd singular preterite, strong verb V)
glossary.symbẹlwynne: symbelwynn — feast-joy, joy of the feast (feminine, accusative singular; symbel 'feast' + wynn 'joy')
glossary.sīðfrome: sīðfrom — eager to be gone, ready for the road (adjective, nominative plural masculine; sīð 'journey' + from 'forward, bold')
glossary.sōcne: sōcn — attack, persecution, visitation (feminine, dative singular, of cause; cf. 'soke')
glossary.unigmetes: unigmetes — exceedingly, immensely (adverb, from the genitive of unigmete 'immense'; un- + gemet 'measure')
glossary.weaxeð: weaxan — grows, waxes (3rd singular present, strong verb VII; cf. 'wax')
glossary.weorð: weorð — dear, esteemed, worthy (adjective, nominative singular masculine; weorð Denum 'dear to the Danes'; cf. 'worth')
glossary.weorðmynda: weorðmynd — honour, dignity (feminine, genitive plural; weorð 'worth' + mynd 'mind, remembrance'; weorðmynda dǣl 'a share of honours')
glossary.wrīdað: wrīdian — flourishes, thrives (3rd singular present, weak verb II)
glossary.wundọrbebodum: wundorbebod — wondrous command (neuter, dative plural, instrumental; wundor 'wonder' + bebod 'command')
glossary.wērgum: wērig — weary (adjective, dative plural masculine; cf. 'weary')
glossary.wīgcræftigne: wīgcræftig — skilled in war (adjective, accusative singular masculine; wīg 'war' + cræftig 'skilled')
glossary.wīggeweorþad: wīggeweorþian — war-honoured, honoured in battle (past participle used as adjective, nominative singular masculine, weak verb II; wīg 'war' + geweorþian 'honour')
glossary.wōm: wōm — stain, sin, wickedness (masculine noun; also taken as a qualifier, 'wicked, foul'; the form and sense are uncertain)
glossary.yppan: yppe — raised place, dais, high seat (weak feminine, dative singular; tō yppan 'to the dais'; related to up)
glossary.æscum: æsc — ash-spear, spear (masculine, dative plural, instrumental; literally 'ash-wood'; cf. 'ash')
glossary.ðec: þū — you (accusative singular, the longer form þec spelled with ð; cf. 'thee')
glossary.þegnes: þegn — thane, retainer (masculine, genitive singular; cf. 'thane')
glossary.þinceð: þyncan — seems (3rd singular present, weak verb; impersonal with the dative of the person; cf. 'methinks')
glossary.þysne: þes — this (demonstrative, accusative singular masculine; cf. 'this')
glossary.þīnes: þīn — your (possessive adjective, genitive singular neuter, agreeing with mægnes; cf. 'thine')
glossary.ēagena: ēage — eye (neuter weak, genitive plural; cf. 'eye')
glossary.ǣrgestrēon: ǣrgestrēon — ancient treasure, hoard of old (neuter, accusative singular; ǣr 'before' + gestrēon 'treasure')
glossary.benam: beniman — took away, deprived (3rd singular preterite, strong verb IV; takes the accusative of the person and the dative of the thing: hine yldo benam mægenes wynnum 'age took the joys of might from him'; cf. 'bereave', 'nim')
glossary.betstan: betst — best (superlative of gōd; weak accusative singular masculine, used as a noun: ðegna betstan 'the best of thanes')
glossary.bewenede: bewenian — entertain, indulge, supply with what one wishes (past participle, nominative plural, with wǣron; willum bewenede 'indulged with our wishes'; the sense rests on this one use)
glossary.blondenfeaxum: blondenfeax — grey-haired (adjective, dative singular masculine, strong; blonden 'mixed', past participle of blandan, + feax 'hair'; the same form serves the dative plural)
glossary.born: beornan — burned (3rd singular preterite, strong verb III, intransitive; cf. 'burn')
glossary.bringan: bringan — to bring (infinitive, irregular weak verb, preterite brōhte; after sceal; cf. 'bring')
glossary.bringe: bringan — bring (1st singular present, with the sense of the future: ic ðē þūsenda bringe 'I will bring you thousands'; cf. 'bring')
glossary.brēostwylm: brēostwylm — welling of the breast, surge of feeling (masculine, accusative singular, object of forberan; brēost 'breast' + wylm 'welling, surge')
glossary.bæð: bæð — bath (neuter, accusative singular, after ofer; ganotes bæð 'the gannet's bath', a poetic name for the sea; cf. 'bath')
glossary.bēoð: bēon — are, will be (3rd plural present; the b-stem, with a general or future sense; cf. 'be')
glossary.dohtest: dugan — avail, be of good to, help (2nd singular preterite, preterite-present verb; takes the dative: þū ūs wēl dohtest 'you were of use to us'; cf. 'doughty')
glossary.feorcȳþðe: feorcȳþð — distant land, far country (feminine, nominative plural; feorr 'far' + cȳþð 'known region, native land')
glossary.forberan: forberan — hold back, endure, forbear (infinitive, strong verb IV; cf. 'forbear')
glossary.fundiaþ: fundian — be bent on, strive, hasten (1st plural present, weak verb II; with an infinitive: wē fundiaþ sēcan 'we are bent on seeking')
glossary.gange: gang — going, way, course (masculine, dative singular; on gange 'on the way, in going'; cf. 'gang')
glossary.ganotes: ganot — gannet, sea-fowl (masculine, genitive singular; cf. 'gannet')
glossary.gecyste: gecyssan — kissed (3rd singular preterite, weak verb I; ge- + cyssan; cf. 'kiss')
glossary.gecēosenne: gecēosan — to choose, pick out (inflected infinitive, dative, after tō: tō gecēosenne 'to choose'; strong verb II; cf. 'choose')
glossary.gefricge: gefricgan (gefrignan) — learn by asking, hear tell (1st singular present, subjunctive after gif though the form is the same in the indicative; strong verb V; ge- + fricgan, also frignan, 'ask')
glossary.gegangeð: gegangan — come about, happen (3rd singular present, indicative; ge- + gangan 'go')
glossary.gegrēttan: gegrēttan — greet, approach, address (infinitive, weak verb I; takes the accusative of the person, with the dative of the gift, as in gōdum 'with good things'; cf. 'greet')
glossary.gemǣne: gemǣne — common, shared, mutual (adjective; nominative singular feminine, agreeing with sib; also nominative plural masculine, agreeing with māþmas; cf. 'mean' in 'common')
glossary.gesyntum: gesynto — health, safety (feminine, dative plural; on gesyntum 'in safety'; cf. 'sound')
glossary.geæhted: geæhtan — appraise, consider, reckon at a value (past participle, nominative singular feminine, agreeing with gifu; weak verb I; the sense is Klaeber's reading of a rare word)
glossary.geþingeð: geþingan (lemma uncertain) — come, resort, make one's way (3rd singular present; sense guessed from the context)
glossary.goldwlanc: goldwlanc — proud of gold, splendid with gold (adjective, nominative singular masculine, strong; gold + wlanc 'proud, splendid')
glossary.græsmoldan: græsmolde — grass-ground, turf (weak feminine, accusative singular, object of træd; græs 'grass' + molde 'earth, ground')
glossary.gār: gār — spear (masculine, nominative singular; cf. 'gar' in 'garlic')
glossary.gārholt: gārholt — spear-wood, spear (neuter, accusative singular, object of bere; gār 'spear' + holt 'wood')
glossary.gōdum: gōd — good (adjective used as a noun, dative plural, instrumental: gōdum gegrēttan 'to greet with good things'; cf. 'good')
glossary.heafu: heaf — sea, ocean (neuter, accusative plural, after ofer; ofer heafu 'over the seas')
glossary.healse: heals — neck (masculine, dative singular, after be; be healse genam 'took by the neck'; cf. 'halse')
glossary.heorugrimme: heorugrimm — sword-fierce, fierce in battle (adjective, nominative singular feminine, agreeing with hild; heoru 'sword' + grimm 'fierce, grim')
glossary.herige: herian — praise, extol (1st singular present, subjunctive after þæt of purpose or result though the form is the same in the indicative; weak verb I)
glossary.hetende: hetend — hater, enemy (masculine, nominative plural; a present-participle noun, from hettan 'pursue, persecute' (cf. hete 'hatred'; editors print hettende); cf. 'hate')
glossary.hofum: hof — court, dwelling, hall (neuter, dative plural, after tō; cf. 'hove' in dialect)
glossary.hringnaca: hringnaca — ring-boat, ship (weak masculine, nominative singular; hring 'ring' + naca 'boat')
glossary.hrēþles: Hrēþel — Hrethel, king of the Geats, father of Higelac and grandfather of Beowulf (genitive singular)
glossary.hrēþrīc: Hrēþrīc — Hrethric, son of Hrothgar (nominative singular)
glossary.hygebendum: hygebend — mind-bond, bond of the mind (dative plural, instrumental after fæst; hyge 'mind' + bend 'bond')
glossary.infrōdum: infrōd — very old, very wise (adjective, dative singular masculine, strong; in 'to the old, very wise one'; in- intensive + frōd)
glossary.inwitnīþas: inwitnīþ — malicious hatred, hostile deed (masculine, nominative plural; inwit 'malice, guile' + nīþ 'hatred, enmity')
glossary.langað: langaþ — longing, yearning (masculine, nominative singular, subject of born; cf. 'long')
glossary.luftācen: luftācen — love-token, sign of love (neuter, accusative singular, object of bringan; lufu 'love' + tācen 'token')
glossary.līcað: līcian — please, be pleasing to (3rd singular present, weak verb II; takes the dative of the person; cf. 'like')
glossary.meþle: meþel — assembly, meeting, council (neuter, dative singular, after on; the same word as maþel in maþelode)
glossary.māþmas: māþm — treasure, precious thing (masculine; nominative plural, subject of wesan, or accusative plural, object of gesealde)
glossary.mōdige: mōdig — high-spirited, bold, proud (adjective, nominative plural masculine, strong, agreeing with the subject hīe; cf. 'moody')
glossary.mōdlufan: mōdlufu — love of the mind, affection (weak feminine; genitive singular, depending on māran, or dative; mōd 'mind' + lufu 'love')
glossary.næbben: næbben — ne + hæbben, have not (3rd plural present subjunctive of habban with the negative joined; subjunctive in a clause of expectation)
glossary.orleahtre: orleahtre — blameless, without fault (adjective, nominative singular masculine, with ǣghwæs 'in everything'; or- 'without' + leahtor 'fault, vice')
glossary.rād: rīdan — rode, sat riding (3rd singular preterite, strong verb I; of a ship, 'lay at anchor'; cf. 'ride')
glossary.sacu: sacu — strife, conflict (feminine, nominative singular, subject of restan; cf. 'sake')
glossary.scōd: sceþþan (scēaþan) — harmed, did harm to (3rd singular preterite, strong verb VI; takes the dative: manegum scōd 'harmed many'; cf. 'scathe')
glossary.seoððan: seoððan (siþþan) — afterwards, thereafter (adverb; spelled with ðð)
glossary.snotorlīcor: snotorlīce — wisely, shrewdly (adverb, comparative -or; from snotor 'wise')
glossary.sŷ: wesan — be (3rd singular present subjunctive; sŷ is a variant of sīe, the subjunctive of the same verb as bēon; used after þēah 'though')
glossary.sǣ-gēatas: Sǣ-Gēatas — Sea-Geats, the Geats as a sea-faring people (nominative plural; sǣ 'sea' + Gēatas)
glossary.sǣgenga: sǣgenga — sea-goer, ship (weak masculine, nominative singular, a poetic name for the ship; sǣ 'sea' + genga 'goer')
glossary.tilian: tilian — strive after, gain, win (infinitive, weak verb II; takes the genitive or accusative of what is sought; cf. 'till')
glossary.twelfe: twelf — twelve (numeral, accusative plural masculine, agreeing with māþmas; cf. 'twelve')
glossary.tēaras: tēar — tear (masculine, nominative plural, subject of hruron; cf. 'tear')
glossary.untǣle: untǣl — blameless, without reproach (adjective, accusative plural masculine, agreeing with lēode; un- 'not' + tǣl 'blame')
glossary.wealde: wealdan — rule, wield, have power over (1st singular present, indicative or subjunctive; takes the genitive: wealde rīces 'rule the realm'; cf. 'wield')
glossary.wigtig: wītig — wise, knowing (adjective, nominative singular masculine, strong, with Drihten; the printed form wigtig is read as a spelling of wītig, with the war-skilled sense from wīg 'battle' as the other possibility; cf. 'wit')
glossary.willum: willa — wish, desire, will (weak masculine, dative plural, instrumental: willum bewenede 'indulged with wishes'; cf. 'will')
glossary.wordcwida: wordcwide — saying, speech (masculine, genitive plural, of respect: wīs wordcwida 'wise in sayings'; word + cwide 'saying')
glossary.wordcwydas: wordcwide — saying, speech (masculine, accusative plural, object of sende; word + cwide 'saying'; the form is spelled with y)
glossary.wyllað: willan — wish, want (1st plural present, with an infinitive: wē secgan wyllað 'we wish to say'; spelled wyllað for willaþ; cf. 'will')
glossary.wylt: willan — will, wish (2nd singular present, with an infinitive: þū healdan wylt 'you will hold'; cf. 'wilt')
glossary.wīs: wīs — wise (adjective, nominative singular masculine, strong; cf. 'wise')
glossary.ymbsittend: ymbsittend — neighbour, one who sits around (masculine, nominative plural; the form is the same in the singular; present participle of ymbsittan used as a noun)
glossary.ðīnne: þīn — your, thy (possessive adjective, accusative singular masculine, agreeing with ealdor; cf. 'thine')
glossary.þūsenda: þūsend — thousand (accusative plural, object of bringe; takes the genitive of the thing counted: þūsenda þegna 'thousands of thanes'; cf. 'thousand')
glossary.þȳwað: þȳwan — press, threaten, oppress (3rd plural present, weak verb I; takes the accusative of the person and the dative of the means: þec egesan þȳwað 'press you with terror')
glossary.āgendfreân: āgendfrēa — owner-lord, rightful lord (weak masculine, accusative singular, object of bād; the form also serves the genitive; āgend 'owner' + frēa 'lord')
glossary.ōwihte: ōwiht (āwiht) — anything, a whit (neuter, dative singular used as an adverb: ōwihte 'in any way, at all'; ā 'ever' + wiht 'thing'; cf. 'aught')
glossary.ǣghwæs: ǣghwæt — everything, each thing (neuter, genitive singular, used as an adverb of respect: ǣghwæs untǣle 'blameless in everything'; cf. 'each' + 'what')
